W_input_schema: annotation_spec_v1.json supplied by coordinator, overview_fields only
W_combination: two distinct annotator IDs; mismatched source SHAs or universes are errors; status/value/page disagreement is unknown
W_scope: document overview, first three physical pages, four named slots
W_normalization: Unicode NFC then whitespace split/join then casefold; formative-field values compared as sets; no synonym, accent or punctuation repair
W_labels: normalized agreement with weak AI reference, not source semantic accuracy, human truth or teacher validation
